glass_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for late evening, but today at 19:26 it was at kitchen_table_k1. This confirms the shift to the kitchen happens earlier than 19:30. Check kitchen_table_k1 for times after 19:00. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 for glasses after 19:00.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for late evening, but today at 19:54 it was at kitchen_table_k1. This indicates the "coffee_table_l1" window for water bottles also ends around 19:00. Check kitchen_table_k1 for times after 19:00. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 for water bottles after 19:00.

mug_dana: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for late evening, but today at 21:50 it was at coffee_table_l1. This contradicts the assumption that mugs move to the kitchen in the evening. Mugs seem to remain at or return to coffee_table_l1 even late at night (post-21:00). Check coffee_table_l1 for mugs in the late evening. Do not default to kitchen_table_k1 for mugs after 21:00.

General Pattern: The "coffee_table_l1 as central hub" heuristic is reliable for Dana’s personal items (glasses, mugs, books, water bottles) from 08:00 through 19:00. However, for glasses and water bottles, the location shifts to kitchen_table_k1 starting around 19:00. For mugs, the location remains at coffee_table_l1 even in the late evening (post-21:00). Do not apply the kitchen shift to mugs. Check kitchen_table_k1 for glasses and water bottles after 19:00, but check coffee_table_l1 for mugs after 21:00.
